Maya Tran: Owners/dates: Erin (SOC2 + questionnaire) Mon EOD, Jonas (diagram) Mon noon, Raj (uploads/presigns) Tue morning. I'll do final bundle review Tue 14:00 PT.
partners-bot: Reminder: marketplace evidence retention is 45 days for Azure pre-listing artifacts.
